title: field-add-spec
description: INPUT of `dmtool -m <model> field add <spec.json>` — a field to add, with its full per-kind config (FEATURE-GAPS §3.4) and field-level metadata (§3.5). The simpler `field add --group --name (--kind|--typedef)` flags cover a bare field; this spec covers everything the typed builders express. Validated against the real kernel before writing. (The flags and this spec are mutually exclusive.)

group.description: the parent group's ABSOLUTE name-path, e.g. /Order (must exist)

name.description: the new field's name (unique within its group)

kind.description: STRING | NUMBER | DATE | TIME | DATETIME | DATERANGE | DATEFRAGMENT | BOOLEAN | CONFIRM | ENUM | CUSTOM (omit when `typedef` is given)

typedef.description: type the field by an existing type-definition id (wins over `kind`)

required.description: true (always required) | false (optional, default) | "ifParentPresent" (required only if the parent group is filled)

label.description: per-locale display label, { "<locale>": "<text>" }; once set, must cover every declared locale

global.description: the kernel `global` flag (relevant to partial validation)

transient.description: the kernel `transient` flag (present at runtime, not persisted)

pattern.description: anchored regex; requires patternMessage. seeAlso: the PatternViolated/PatternMatched operators — the rule-level alternative (`operators PatternViolated`)

patternMessage.description: the error text shown when the pattern fails

suggestions.description: per-locale hint list, { "<locale>": ["…"] }; validated against the field's own pattern

maxFractionalDigits.description: the decimal scale; together they bound the fraction-digit range

min.description: minimum value (decimal as a string). seeAlso: the LessThan/GreaterThan comparison operators — rule-level bounds

values.description: ≥1 { value, labels? } — stored value + optional per-locale labels. seeAlso: FieldValueIncludedInValueList — the rule-level way to restrict a field to a value set

categories.description: named classifications; each has values[] aligned 1:1 with the enum values

invalidValueMessage.description: error text for an out-of-domain value (one text, all locales)
